features.description: Project scaffolding with build system and entry point
steps: Verify project directories exist (src/, tests/)
Run go build ./... and confirm exit code 0
Run ./todo-cli --help and confirm usage output is printed

features.description: Add task to the todo list with a title
steps: Run ./todo-cli add 'Buy groceries'
Verify output confirms task was added
Check internal storage contains the task with correct title

features.description: List all tasks with their completion status
steps: Add two tasks: 'Task A' and 'Task B'
Run ./todo-cli list
Verify both tasks appear with pending status

features.description: Mark a task as completed by its ID
steps: Add a task, note its ID
Run ./todo-cli complete <id>
Run ./todo-cli list and verify task shows as completed

features.description: Delete a task by its ID
steps: Add two tasks
Run ./todo-cli delete <id-of-first>
Run ./todo-cli list and verify only second task remains

features.description: Persist tasks to disk so they survive process restart
steps: Add a task
Kill the process and restart
Run ./todo-cli list and verify task is still present

features.description: Show usage help for each subcommand
steps: Run ./todo-cli add --help
Verify add-specific help is shown, not generic usage
Repeat for list, complete, delete subcommands

features.description: Unit tests for all command handlers
steps: Run go test ./... -v
Verify all tests pass with coverage > 80%

features.description: Color-coded output: green for done, yellow for pending
steps: Add completed and pending tasks
Run ./todo-cli list
Visually verify completed tasks are green, pending are yellow

features.description: README with installation, usage, and examples
steps: Read README.md
Verify it contains: install instructions, all subcommands documented, example output
